main_body: A green hedge/bush block about 36x14 px: a light green top band with leaf-clump speckles above a darker green front face, ending in a dark base row.
top_band: light/mid green, rows ~1-5 (about 5 rows), with lighter leaf-clump dots; a step to darker green at row ~6
evidence: Column through the middle: dark outline row 0, then rows 1-5 of light green with speckle highlights (top surface), an abrupt tone change at row 6 to mid/dark green foliage (rows 6-12) with dark clumps, then a dark base at rows 13-14. A top band of 5 rows and a front face of about 7 rows are both clearly drawn. There is no distinct front-edge line, but the tone step plus the darker foliage below works as the eave. For an organic hedge this reads as a 3/4 form.

style.evidence: The hedge uses about 4 greens (light, mid, dark, deep) with scattered highlight dots and dark clumps, and its dark green outline matches the leaves, with no black sticker line. Next to the stall and well references, which carry 5-6 steps with per-tile highlights and grain, it is thinner. The foliage clumps are blocky, with few distinct leaf shapes, and the lower face has large mid-green areas with little variation. Texture is present but sparse, so it reads a little lower in density than the references and falls short of the Beodeul bar.
